# Local Business Phone, Email & WhatsApp Scraper (`local-business-website-phone-whatsapp-scraper-mcp-api`)

> Extract direct landlines, mobile numbers, WhatsApp click-to-chat links, and contact emails from local business websites. Built for local agency lead generation.

## Endpoints & Connections
- Apify Store URL: https://apify.com/deepaksheoran172/local-business-website-phone-whatsapp-scraper
- Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP): `https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=deepaksheoran172/local-business-website-phone-whatsapp-scraper`
- Stdio MCP: `npx -y @apify/actors-mcp-server --actors deepaksheoran172/local-business-website-phone-whatsapp-scraper`
- Execution Mode: Serverless Batch & MCP Tool
- Full 63-Actor Catalog: https://deepakshe.github.io/b2b-mcp-apify-scrapers-hub/llms.txt
